job_title: Open AI API Integration and fine-tuning
cover_letter: You need to integrate the OpenAI API for da‑vinci‑003 and codex and then fine‑tune the models for your chatbot mobile app. I have built production‑grade HTTP services for machine‑learning models using FastAPI, Pydantic request models, health checks and Docker containers, as shown in my model‑serving template repository [ai_ml_engineer-repo-model-serving-template-readme-md] and its app code [ai_ml_engineer-repo-model-serving-template-app-py]. The same pattern was used to expose a `/match` endpoint for a CV‑ranking service, demonstrating ability to wrap complex model logic behind a clean API [ai_ml_engineer-repo-cv-matcher-readme-md]. My skill set includes Python, FastAPI, Docker, MLflow and Hugging Face transformers, which are directly relevant for loading, calling and fine‑tuning large language models [ai_ml_engineer-cv-skills]. I have also designed pipelines that combine rule‑based logic with machine‑learning models, as in a payments fraud detection case study [ai-cs-11]. I would confirm the exact OpenAI integration details on a brief call.
